# Bitrush

> Bitrush (https://bitrush.online) mines Bitcoin in the browser. It explains how Bitcoin mining works, creates a wallet on the visitor's device and mines with one button. No sign-up, no download.

- Mining starts only when the visitor presses Mine BTC, and stops when they press it again. It runs on the device's processor, so the device may warm up; a Speed slider (0 to 100%) turns it down, and 0 pauses it.
- The wallet: an address (safe to share; where bitcoin is sent) and 12 words (the wallet's password: never share or lose them; made in the browser and never sent anywhere). A visitor can also upload a wallet file or paste an address they already have.
- How Bitcoin mining works: Bitcoin is like a bank, but instead of paying employees, it pays its miners. About every 10 minutes, new payments are packed into a block. To add it, computers race to find a hash that starts with about 19 zeros; there's no shortcut, only guessing. The winner gets 3.125 new bitcoin plus the block's fees, the only way new bitcoin is made.
- If a visitor's browser finds a block, the payout goes to their address once the block is confirmed, about 100 blocks (around 17 hours) later.
- Privacy: the site counts visits and button presses, never the 12 words or addresses.

## Pages

- [Bitrush](https://bitrush.online/): the one screen (the wallet setup, with a short tutorial over it on a first visit, then the miner)
